entities.summary: Lucciana Cathedral, officially the Cathedral of Saint Mary of the Assumption of Lucciana, is a Roman Catholic church located in the town of Lucciana, Corsica. The former cathedral is a national monument. Lucciana Cathedral is a cathedral in Europe, established in 1119. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
